title: SISO Fading Channel
text: Filter input signal through SISO multipath fading channel, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Discrete path delays (s)} sets Delays for each discrete path; {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the option to inherit the sample rate, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the input signal sample rate, {Average path gains (dB)} sets the average gain for each discrete path, {Normalize average path gains to 0 dB} sets the option to normalize average path gains, {Fading distribution}, {K-factors} sets the k-factor of Rician fading channel, {LOS path Doppler shifts (Hz)} sets the doppler shifts for line-of-sight, {LOS path initial phases (rad)} sets the initial phases for line-of-sight, {Maximum Doppler shift (Hz)} sets the maximum Doppler shift for all channel, {Doppler spectrum}, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator initial seed, {Output channel path gains} sets the option to output channel path gains, {Output channel filter delay} sets the option to output channel filter delay, {Simulate using} sets the compilation type Interpreted, {Channel visualization} selects the channel visualization, {Percentage of samples to display} and {Path for Doppler spectrum display} sets the path for which Doppler spectrum. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Out1
ports.summary: Output data signal for fading channel vector

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Option to inherit the sample rate from input on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Input signal sample rate 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discrete path delays (s)
params.values: Delays for each discrete path 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar | row vector

params.name: Average path gains (dB)
params.values: Average gain for each discrete path 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Normalize average path gains to 0 dB
params.values: Option to normalize average path gains to 0 dB on (default) | off

params.name: Fading distribution
params.values: Fading distribution of channel Rayleigh (default) | Rician

params.name: K-factors
params.values: K-factor of Rician fading channel 3 (default) | positive scalar | row vector of nonnegative values

params.name: LOS path Doppler shifts (Hz)
params.values: Doppler shifts for line-of-sight components 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: LOS path initial phases (rad)
params.values: Initial phases for line-of-sight components 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Maximum Doppler shift (Hz)
params.values: Maximum Doppler shift for all channel paths 0.001 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Doppler spectrum
params.values: Doppler spectrum shape for all channel paths doppler(’Jakes’) (default) | doppler(’Flat’) | doppler(’Rounded’,...) | doppler(’Bell’,...) | doppler(’Asymmetric Jakes’,...) | doppler(’Restricted Jakes’,...) | doppler(’Gaussian’,...) | doppler(’BiGaussian’,...)

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Random number generator initial seed 73 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Output channel path gains
params.values: Option to output channel path gains off (default) | on

params.name: Output channel filter delay
params.values: Option to output channel filter delay off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Compilation type Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Channel visualization
params.values: Select the channel visualization Off (default) | Impulse response | Frequency response | Doppler spectrum | Impulse and frequency responses

params.name: Path for Doppler spectrum display
params.values: Path for which Doppler spectrum is displayed 1 (default) | positive integer
